messages:
Chris (Design): quick design check  the token counter jumps when stream is stopped mid-chunk. feels janky. idea: freeze token number + show a soft shimmer for 120ms so users perceive a smooth stop.
Sam (PM): sounds reasonable. want to make sure we don't hide the fact that tokens were skipped (cost visibility). maybe show a tiny suffix: "(final)"?
Ravi (Eng): we can snapshot the count on stop and freeze updates. shimmer implemented via CSS transition. showing "(final)" is cheap.
Noor (DevEx): edge case: if user clicks Regenerate right after Stop, we currently enqueue the regen which sometimes reuses partial KV and leads to subtle context bleed. prefer Cancel+New.
Maya (A11y): if we add shimmer/"final" label, ensure it's announced: aria-live polite with "Generation finished". Also keyboard users should see focus stay on the composer controls.
Chris (Design): mock: stop flow = Streaming -> Freeze (token locked + shimmer + "final") -> Idle. regen during Freeze = immediate abort + new run.
Ravi (Eng): implementation plan: on stop set freeze window = 120ms. Regen during freeze triggers abort handler with "regen_source=manual" tag. throttle token updates to 60ms to reduce repaints.
Noor (DevEx): when prompt library items are inserted during an active stream, don't auto-send. instead show micro-toast: "Inserted: click Send to run" and keep focus in composer. current behavior stomps the input.
Chris (Design): micro-toast should be subtle and dismissible. position: above composer, not covering controls.
Maya (A11y): toast must use role=alert and keyboard dismiss (Esc). color contrast needs review.
Sam (PM): what about copy on the Stop button? users confuse Stop vs Cancel sometimes. propose tooltip: "Stop generation" and a small helper: "Esc" to stop in the composer hint area.
Ravi (Eng): will add keyboard binding Esc -> stop, and ensure it's idempotent. also add feature flag: ui.freeze-stop-experience to roll out.
Noor (DevEx): telemetry events: stop_mode=immediate vs stop_mode=freeze, regen_after_stop, prompt_insert_during_stream. I'll draft schemas.
ci-bot: CI pipeline triggered for branch: feature/freeze-stop. :gear:
Chris (Design): action items: I'll push updated Figma with shimmer and final badge. Maya please sanity-check announcements. Noor, Ravi will coordinate flag + telemetry.
Maya (A11y): will run a quick a11y spec pass tomorrow.
Noor (DevEx): drafting telemetry + will post in #eng-analytics.
Sam (PM): thanks team  we'll gate the experiment behind the flag and measure regen rate + perceived interruption via quick NPS.
Chris (Design): closing, thanks!
